Level 1: 'Romance' Death theme.
Level 2: Customisable Love-Heart sun-glasses.
Level 3: 'Pizza-Delivery Guy' Death theme.

Hello!

As the official sponsors of San Paro’s Fight Club system Joker Industries are thrilled to send to you a Joker Ticket for your participation in Joker Industries sponsored events! 

We’ve partnered with Wilde Designs inc, Ophelia Customs LLC and Armas Marketplace to bring you everything you need to help you in your fight for supremacy over San Paro. Take these tickets to the Joker Distribution Center in the Breakwater Marina and speak to the Joker Representatives, Ophelia or Wilde, about exchanging them (along with a small amount of cash) for something new and exclusive.

Vehicles by Ophelia Customs, clothes crafted by the brilliant minds at Wilde Designs and weapons from Armas Marketplace are all easily available to you from our Distribution Center. There’s things that you can’t get any other way and rewards that you’ve had a taste of in the past but can keep forever.

You want to prove to everyone that you’re the best? Save up those tickets and spend them on The Crown Imperial. You want to get tickets faster? Spend them on a new Armas Marketplace weapon to help you out when a new league begins. You want that Vegas G20 4X4 back? Save up for the permanent version or spend them for the leased version. Joker Industries makes it so the choice is finally yours.

Wojtek Pajac, CEO Joker Industries, incorporating Joker Gunworks and Joker Ammunition.

Hello everyone,

Attached to this mail are a number of consumable items. They can be equipped in the 4th slot of your Character Mods section, and triggered with the '4' key by default. This is a very early test and certainly a lot of these will be buggy as all hell, but it's enough for some initial impressions.

One thing to keep in mind is that none of these items are locked to the person that deploys them. As long as you are relevant to them, you can essentially steal the item by picking it up.

Testing Weapons -

The word "money" is believed to originate from a temple of Hera, located on Capitoline, one of Rome's seven hills. In the ancient world Hera was often associated with money. The temple of Juno Moneta at Rome was the place where the mint of Ancient Rome was located. The name "Juno" may derive from the Etruscan goddess Uni (which means "the one", "unique", "unit", "union", "united") and "Moneta" either from the Latin word "monere" (remind, warn, or instruct) or the Greek word "moneres" (alone, unique).
In the Western world, a prevalent term for coin-money has been specie, stemming from Latin in specie, meaning 'in kind'.

The days might be warm in San Paro, but there’s plenty of stone-cold killers on the streets. It might not be bulletproof, but keep yourself warm with a knitted beanie.

Some looks never get old. This vintage backpack hasn't had to change design and it never will. Practical and street-smart this bag is the perfect place to store whatever you need to get the job done.
No longer the uniform of grandfathers or hipsters, the flatcap is an essential piece of millinery for the discerning gentleman. Don't be caught without one!

Arm Pads. These graphene laced Arm Pads are the latest and greatest examples of personal protection. They provide full coverage of the upper arm whilst maintaining perfect mobility. Should prevent bruises from rifle recoil impacts.

The ultimate in street racer safety gear, repurposed for urban combat. Gone are the extra safety features, replaced by more gear loops and super strong harness straps and a hoop to keep you in your seat during even the most violent of crashes.

This Tactical Harness features titanium hoops and links, hard wearing nylon fabrics and leather straps. As well as being able to be equipped with multiple weapon configs, it lifts, protects and separates.

Impact Arm Pads. High impact Kevlar threads have been woven through these 1000cc grade bike armor pads. They’ll keep your arms and shoulders protected regardless if you’re flyin’ through the air because you just went off a ramp at full speed or because you just took a 'nade to the feet.
This compact backpack stays close to your body while providing a large amount of storage in a sleek modern style.
Perfect for stacking ammo, kit, or stolen gold, the Militia Backpack is a classic military style used by armies around the world for its ruggedness and good looks.
A traditional Scottish kilt that’s just as at home in Gresty as it is in the Glens. Use it wisely, for the kilt is a powerful weapon.
A Goth Kilt. Just like a regular kilt only it comes with pockets so you can store your XSChill, spare ammunition or live haggis.

Stomping around the streets of San Paro is heavy duty work. Make sure your boots are up to the job. These might not prevent broken toes when they're run over, but dropping a stolen TV or PC tower on 'em should be ok. We think.

A real Juggernaut doesn’t stop for anything, and that means being able to power through whatever the streets can throw at you. Whether you use your knees to beat down doors or beat up chumps, these kneepads will make you harder to bring down.
The Machinegunner chest-rig configuration can be attached to most types of body armor and webbing.
The Machinegunner vest configuration can be attached to most types of body armor and webbing.
These bad boys are comfy and stylish. Nobody's gonna question your street cred in a pair of high top kicks, whether you're at the skatepark or putting the foot down as you race through Havalynd.

It's a rare thing for comfort and fashion to meet so seamlessly, as they do in these baggy jeans! If you're planning on running anywhere, it might be worth pairing them up with a belt to avoid any embarrassing stumbling.
Cargo Capri Shorts. These capri shorts are made of a light canvas fabric and are tied off at the bottom of each leg. They’re left baggy down the legs for good mobility.
Being in vogue can be tough sometimes, but this long sleeved, fashionable top makes it look easy.

Armored Vest Collar. Based off the classic Medieval gorget, this collar might be a little overkill if you plan on getting into any jousting contests any time soon but it provides full coverage of the neck and throat.

Functionally perfect, this helmet makes no exceptions for the fashion conscious of you out there. Huge air filters on the front and a one-way-glass visor gives you a visage that no one can stare down.
Hardened plastic and carbon fiber come together in this amazing piece of headgear. The visor is self-cleaning and the air filtration system keeps what you’re breathing pure.

Impact Forearm Pads. These forearm pads are tough, sturdy and ready for action. They’re held around the arm with elasticized straps for comfort and security because who needs to worry about armor falling off when you’re doing a drive-by?
Large safety goggles.
A custom tailored Ghillie shirt. It’s a must for the long nights in the hottest clubs in Havalynd. Breathable, open collared and so stylish it hurts.
A Goth Ghillie Shirt. It’s made from silk, leather and metal. Wear this and it might just be you that goes bump in the night.

We know it's been a while since you've been able to get to a barber. We don't judge, but this baggy beanie will help you keep your flowing locks nice and tidy. Oh, and they're totally "in" this year, too!
When your local supermarket is in Gresty, a normal kevlar vest doesn't cut it when popping out for your weekly shop. This version comes with Ceramic Plates stitched throughout.
High-end Kevlar vest with a nanofiber weave for the utmost in comfort and protection. The riveted plates help deflect glancing blows while acting as a great canvas for graffiti.
What's an outfit without a hat to top it off? Combining a pair of goggles with this very chic hat was a stroke of genius, even if we do say so ourselves...which we do.
The Grenades vest configuration can be attached to most types of body armor and webbing.
Because regular people's jeans just ain't good enough for such a snappy dresser. Make a statement with some distinctive denim.

Armored Groin Pad, Rear. Ever since coming to San Paro this piece of armor tends to be less about protecting ones behind and more about providing advertising space. That and as a prime location for a KISS HERE sign for you to shake at your enemies.

Pulled from the hottest drivers in the Nantego 700 circuit, this Racing Suit is the last word in clothing for the fashion conscious high performance driver. It’s padded yet breathable to keep you comfortable as you enter your tenth lap of Havalynd.
Originally designed for use at fifty thousand feet, this suit’s been brought back down to earth with a bump when it was found to be perfectly adept in the on-going ground conflict of San Paro.

Impact Shin Pads. Ever notice nobody in this city opens doors with their hands? The old ‘feet-first meet-and-greet’? When your shin armor looks this good who can blame you for wanting them to be the first thing people see of you?
A rib stitch woolen kilt sock.
Ok, so you wanna look tough. But San Paro can get cold at night. What's gonna do the job of keeping out the cold but looking suitably intimidating? This beaded scarf does a pretty good job.

While it’s important for a Juggernaut to keep moving, it’s essential to keep yourself protected. This nylon flight jacket allows for completely unhindered movement, while providing a solid layer of protection against the normal detritus of San Paro’s streets.
A buttoned denim jacket with a cotton hood. Wear with jeans for a perfect look.
Nothing says "night out on the town" like your favourite dancing shoes. These buckle-down brogues are made for painting the town red.
Whoever said ‘the best defence is a good offence’ never had an OSMAW Hero dive out of a moving vehicle and shoot a rocket at their junk. Wear this. You’ll thank us later.

Crash Helmet. This crash helmet comes with a beaked visor, air filter and goggles. It’s chunky, heavy duty but still light and breathable. Exactly what you need when you’re sprinting towards the enemy and don’t want sweat getting in your eyes before you line up that perfect shot.
An older type of webbing belt supporting the matching left and right Thigh Rig.
When a leather jacket isn't rock n' roll enough, add metal! This zipped up leather jacket comes with the sleeves rolled up, so people know that you mean business.

If you’re planning on being a walking tank, it’s vital to carry an arsenal with you. The tactical trousers are a comfortable, tough and practical means of holding all you need to lay down some serious firepower.
Heavy knit wool with additional reinforcement on the arms and shoulders. This sturdy and warm jumper won't let you down.

A staple of the “tough-guy” look; the Y-back muscle shirt is the perfect base layer for San Paro’s “man on a mission”. If you’re wearing it on its own, it might not offer much protection, but you’ll be letting the city know that you’re not afraid of anyone.
Combat trousers made from heavy cloth for improved wear resistance. Built in knee-pads help save your joints while you bounding overwatch your way through San Paro.

Armored Shoulder Pads. Thinner than one might expect but, according to the brochure, it’s designed for mobility and protection in ‘impact rich environments’ which has got to count for something, right?

With plenty of impact soaking potential these thigh pads have pretty much everything the budding Criminal needs to take on the world. Quick release buckles, nylon straps, Kevlar plates! No pockets though… can’t win ‘em all I guess.

Based on the Paladin Body Defense Armor developed by Somatic Advanced Tactical Systems, this Armored Vest is tested to destruction every single day by Enforcers throughout San Paro. Try it out and see why it’s number one.
The Rifleman chest rig configuration can be attached to most types of body armor and webbing.
Based off the classic Japanese haidate style, these Armored Thigh Pads provide good coverage whilst maintaining mobility.

Initially designed to defend the body from blunt-force-trauma, this once athletics grade body armor has seen a string of upgrades bringing it to near military specifications. It’ll stop a bullet or a grenade blast as well as anything else on the market.

These boots will reinforce that you're here to do business. Sure, that business involves tearing around San Paro at speed, shooting your enemies and blowing stuff up. At least in these boots, you're bound to turn heads while you do it.

When it comes to headgear in San Paro, it's testament to the toughness of its denizens that so many people choose stylish sophistication over bulletproof armour. This Bakerboy hat represents a commitment to fashion that tells everyone its wearer is hard as nails.

The cornerstone of the modern man's wardrobe must be the hoodie. It really ties the whole outfit together! It's just as well that this one is the perfect item of clothing for today's street-savvy gentleman.

This stylish waistcoat and tie combination is perfect for almost any social occasion. What if you need to leave your formal drinks reception so you can ride shotgun while you take down your enemies? We think we've got just the threads you need.

The days of "pristine" clothing are well behind us. In San Paro, you're trying way too hard if you don't have at least a couple of bullet holes in your favourite jeans. We cut out the whole "shot in the leg" phase and jump straight to putting some awesome patches on these trendy jeans.

A ¾ length protective anorak that has been a popular sight on both Military and Milan stages since the 50s. Its high caliber cotton-nylon blend, polyester wadding and fur ruffs make this a lightweight comfortable fit that will keep you warm through the cold San Paro nights.

You can never have enough shotgun shells for a day out in San Paro. The amount of shotgun wielding maniacs may have something to do with the lack of local wildlife. This vest offers a combination of style and practicality that keeps spare shells within easy reach. This item does require the tactical vest to be worn before it can be equipped.

What self-respecting criminal would run a high yield operation without first disguising themseves? The classic ski mask balaclava is designed to let the opposition know that you mean business. Add symbols and colour schemes to make your presence known.
While not exactly comfortable, these patch-work leather trousers come adorned with chains and a ram-skull buckle, ensuring the sacrifices you make for style are properly appreciated.
These four pouches give combatants some extra space to store magazines or whatever else they want. Soda or a beer, perhaps? (This item requires a chest rig/vest to be worn before it can be applied)
A tight fitting three-quarter length top, with absolutely nothing special about it. It certainly hasn't been ravaged by wild beasts. No Refunds!

Nothing says "I've been through my share of scrapes" like these "battle damaged" turn ups. Who buys unworn jeans these days, anyway? Also comes with some pretty cool braces (for fashion purposes of course.)

Gas Mask (Side Filter). Made from tempered, durable rubber this gas mask is guaranteed to keep your breathing air filtered for one thousand hours. It features one way glass over the eyes so only you can see the whites of their eyes but they can't see yours.
Additional webbing for players who need all the pockets they can get their hands on. (Or in!) ((This item requires a chest rig/vest to be worn before it can be applied)
A schoolgirl crop top. Get a pair of katana’s, a cute and fuzzy sidekick and you’re half way towards your own Ryoko Nakao tribute act.
A schoolgirl skirt. 100% cotton and schoolgirl cut. Someone ‘accidentally’ moved a zero from the length to order number category when ordering skirts for San Paro High. This is the result.
Remember being told ‘no way are you leaving the house like that, young lady’? Now who’s in charge, dad?
Rib knit legwarmers that are thick enough to keep you warm whilst waiting for that next dispatch.
The Goth crop top is perfect for the good-girl-gone-bad. How bad is up to you though.

Being tough doesn’t mean you can’t be fashionable too. The halter-top allows for unimpeded movement, but also protects your chest. All the buckles and corsetry not only look stylish, but they allow for a more comfortable feel.
Perfect for hot sunny days and hot steamy nights, this dress is a versatile addition to any stylish ensemble.
Every day is a sunny day in San Paro. Make a statement with your choice of sunglasses. You know you're better than everyone else, now they can know it too!

These boots will reinforce that you're here to do business. Sure, that business involves tearing around San Paro at speed, shooting your enemies and blowing stuff up. At least in these boots, you're bound to turn heads while you do it.
Women in San Paro need to be tougher than most, to spend all day dominating their enemies. It's only right that they wear the right boots for the job.
You don't need to be in a firefight to "feel the heat" in San Paro. Chill out in these fashionable high-waisted shorts, perfect for showing off your bad-ass thigh tattoos.

There's a good reason that corsets have stuck around for centuries : They look awesome. Comfort takes a back seat while discerning wearers dress to impress. A perfect addition to a formal outfit or your favourite costume.
In a world where bullets are flying and car chases are constantly taking place, nothing shows more confidence in your survival skills like a midriff show. Ain't nobody taking you down!
An Alice band with a small bow set to the side.
The classic rock n' roll staple. No self respecting rocker would be seen without them. The studded leather look will never die. When it looks this good, who's gonna argue with you?
A copped hooded jacket. This hooded jacket is made from cotton and silk inner lining. Warm, soft and comfortable – just what you need after a long day on the streets.
An incredibly worn and ripped pair of jeans with parts replaced by leather, these should have been thrown out years ago!
